name: 77488 · Wharton, TX
findings: ZIP 77488 (Wharton) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77488 (Wharton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
